elements.requirement: A testator must express a wish that property bequeathed by his will should be transferred by the legatee to other persons.
elements.quote: Where a testator expresses a wish that property bequeathed by his will should be transferred by the legatee to other persons

elements.requirement: The legatee must transfer any of the bequeathed property in accordance with the testator's wish within the period of two years after the death of the testator.
elements.quote: the legatee transfers any of the property in accordance with that wish within the period of two years after the death of the testator

elements.requirement: The Inheritance Tax Act 1984 takes effect as if the transferred property had been bequeathed by the testator's will directly to the transferee.
elements.quote: this Act shall have effect as if the property transferred had been bequeathed by the will to the transferee

thresholds.what: the period after the death of the testator within which the legatee must transfer the property
thresholds.quote: within the period of two years after the death of the testator
